acceptance_tests.pass_condition: Receipt contains statuses, counts, hashes, timestamps, and filenames only.
Receipt excludes raw lane text, raw prompts, private traces, credentials, screenshots, and local absolute paths.
Status-check cadence guard passes before lane harvest.
No new sibling, thread, or old-style subagent is created.
App receipts pass redaction before direct repair gate.
CLI quality and marker review pass before five-lane normalizer.
Phase-advance verifier passes only after app, CLI, classifier, exposure, closeout, and next-prep receipts are present.
GMUT, canon, consciousness, and final-physics gates remain open unless exact closure artifacts exist.

next_use: Run this acceptance list against v8 launch and closeout packages.
Use failed acceptance tests as repair tasks, not as reasons for broad mutation.
Keep helper changes repo-scoped and exact-staged.
